issue_context.title: [Enhancement]  rocketMQProtocolDecode optimize
issue_context.body:
### Before Creating the Enhancement Request

- [X] I have confirmed that this should be classified as an enhancement rather than a bug/feature.


### Summary

1. Judgment optimization 
It is better to compare the length of the remark and extFields with the current remaining readable length rather than directly with the length of the header.
![1694880196380](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/assets/44110731/caf110b6-e65d-4a26-9280-a71167bed99a)

2 Parameter Naming Optimization
This should not be named headerBuffer, as the byteBuffer passed in here also contains body data.
![1694880554905](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/assets/44110731/02ed866a-4a06-43f0-a154-39f90ae69909)



### Motivation

By comparison, it can be more accurate and early to determine whether the data in byteBuffer is normal

### Describe the Solution You'd Like

It is better to compare the length of the remark and extInfo with the current remaining readable length rather than directly with the length of the header.

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered

It is better to compare the length of the remark and extInfo with the current remaining readable length rather than directly with the length of the header.

### Additional Context

_No response_

review_comments: 变量建议在使用的时候再声明
嗯，但这里是记录当前读位移，需要在此时记录
引入一个新的变量，似乎增加了复杂性
我到不这么认为，因为我认为一方面这里就应该声明一个变量来表示这里的长度，这样会更加易于理解与维护，另一方面可以提高校验的准确性。
修改命名以后`headerLen`和`byteBuffer`似乎没有对应关系
个人认为原来的命名是跟业务比较相关，如果是通用的工具方法的话，命名byteBuffer没有任何问题。但是这个方法应该就是操作header，原来的命名会更具可读性
